eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 10:55 AM on AUG 28, 2023 Effective until 10:55 AM AUG 29, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office is downgrading to Mandatory Evacuation Order in your area to Voluntary in light of progress made with Tiger Island Fire. We ask to to remain vigilant and informed to be prepared to leave if a higher threat arises again. This area is from Seth Cole Road east to Williams/Vigor Miers Rd to include both sides of Highway 190W north to the Parish line and south to Jack Nelson Rd. Be prepared to evacuate should the fire escalate
